feature_assessment.summary: 新增 score centering 训练语义和数据/指标路径，需确认在 MegatronAdaptor 的 loss/logprob 数据链保持分数归一化契约。
把 score centering 接入 top-p routing replay；要验证 reference/policy logprob 与 replay mask 一致。

feature_assessment.capability: 移除旧 rollout 全局 dataset flag
feature_assessment.summary: 删除旧全局数据源参数并调整 rollout source/placement 配置；检查 Ascend 配置和自定义插件入参。
引入分布式 fully-async rollout 和 Straw 数据/传输能力，是较大范围 rollout/data 架构迁移，需验证 Ray/NPU 资源与异步队列不变量。

feature_assessment.capability: 上游新增 Ascend accelerator backend
feature_assessment.summary: 上游已有 NPU accelerator API；复用其通用接口并保留本地 torch_npu bootstrap、MegatronAdaptor hook 与 Ray NPU resource name。

feature_assessment.capability: QueueDataSource 缓冲和 API 清理
feature_assessment.summary: 移除 queue buffer 并整理 fully-async data source/transport；需覆盖序列化、回收和并行队列边界。

feature_assessment.capability: Straw checkpoint rollback 与索引归档
feature_assessment.summary: 增加 checkpoint rollback 和 indexed rollout archives，需保证恢复顺序、数据索引与权重版本一致。

feature_assessment.capability: 移除过时 Straw queue limits
feature_assessment.summary: 删除旧队列限额参数并更新队列/transport schema；检查 NPU 测试配置中残留参数。

feature_assessment.capability: Pipeline RL 支持 flush cache interval
feature_assessment.summary: 支持 pipeline RL 周期清理 cache/同步权重，需验证 MA/TENPU optimizer 与 rollout 的 flush 时序。

feature_assessment.capability: reference logprobs 禁止 top-p replay
feature_assessment.summary: 避免 reference logprob 计算意外应用 top-p replay；适用于 PPO/OPD 正确性检查。

feature_assessment.capability: 保留 serving 的手动 Megatron restart
feature_assessment.summary: 允许训练 actor 手动重启同时保留 serving，影响 Ray job/engine 生命周期与恢复流程。
修复 Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next Context Parallel 下线性注意力梯度错误，必须以多 rank 数值对照验证。

feature_assessment.capability: disk delta 权重同步尊重 checkpoint shard index
feature_assessment.summary: 按 checkpoint shard index 选择 disk delta checkpoint，必须检查分片权重重载与版本一致性。

feature_assessment.capability: 发布 v0.4.0 与依赖基线更新
feature_assessment.summary: release tag 固定目标；Docker/requirements 同时更新 Megatron commit 与若干 CUDA 构建依赖，训练侧依赖差异需单独审计。

docker/Dockerfile: # SGLang instead of replacing its Blackwell inference kernels with FA2.
cd flash-attention/ && git checkout 002cce0a1068f8c07dfccb5a1d232b9a3276947c && git submodule update --init && \
# FlashQLA currently requires TileLang 0.1.9, while SGLang 0.5.15.post1 on
# the default FLA backend on CUDA 13 instead of downgrading SGLang's runtime.
# The cu13 TE wheel is built against a newer cuBLAS than SGLang's CUDA 13.0
# zhuzilin fork builds, grouped together right after Megatron-LM:
# torch_memory_saver, plus the GLM-5 train/rollout alignment kernels
# DeepGEMM's batch-invariant kernel selection; build the SGLang-compatible wheel.
# Megatron currently requires NumPy 1.x, while SciPy 1.18+ requires NumPy 2.x.
RUN python -c "import sglang_router; assert 'slime' in sglang_router.__version__"
echo "megatron-sglang-aligned.patch failed to apply cleanly. Please resolve conflicts." && \
# TODO temporarily skip patching for GB200/GB300 (and require users to bring their own sglang version). should add back later.
for patch in sglang.patch sglang-top_p.patch sglang-release_hicache.patch sglang-pull_weights.patch sglang-deterministic.patch; do \
echo "Patch $patch does not apply to the SGLang source in the base image."; \
requirements.txt: memray  # needed for debugging (but is lightweight), we can put it to dev mode when using pyproject.toml

docker/Dockerfile: # Resolve NCCL consistently for PyTorch, SGLang and the official TE core wheel.
# PyTorch 2.11 and CUDA 12; FA3 comes from the official PyTorch wheel index.
# On CUDA 13, keep the base image's FA4 kernels for Blackwell.
# FlashQLA currently requires TileLang 0.1.9, while SGLang 0.5.15.post1 on
# the default FLA backend on CUDA 13 instead of downgrading SGLang's runtime.
# Use the official TE core wheel; only its PyTorch bindings need compilation.
pip uninstall -y transformer-engine transformer-engine-cu12 transformer-engine-cu13 transformer-engine-torch && \
# zhuzilin fork builds, grouped together right after Megatron-LM:
# torch_memory_saver, plus the GLM-5 train/rollout alignment kernels
# DeepGEMM's batch-invariant kernel selection; build the SGLang-compatible wheel.
# Megatron currently requires NumPy 1.x, while SciPy 1.18+ requires NumPy 2.x.
# requirements.txt installs sglang-router and its dependencies above. Replace
# only the router with the fork wheel; re-resolving its unbounded dependencies
RUN python -c "import sglang_router; assert 'slime' in sglang_router.__version__"
for patch_name in megatron.patch megatron-sglang-aligned.patch; do \
# Custom base images can opt out of the SGLang patch stack.
for patch in sglang.patch sglang-top_p.patch sglang-release_hicache.patch sglang-pull_weights.patch sglang-deterministic.patch; do \
echo "Patch $patch does not apply to the SGLang source in the base image."; \
# PyTorch's dependency metadata pins older NCCL. Restore the tested runtime
# after all resolving installs, without changing PyTorch or other packages.
requirements.txt: memray  # needed for debugging (but is lightweight), we can put it to dev mode when using pyproject.toml
